chunks: Ishaq said: Muhammad ibn al-Rabi' al-Sha'i informed me, saying:
I debated a man from the Dualists in al-Ahwaz, then I came to Surra Man Ra'a, while something from his doctrine had remained attached to my heart.

As I was sitting at the door of Ahmad ibn al-Khadib, Abu Muhammad عليه السلام approached from the residence of the authorities, heading toward the procession. He looked at me and gestured with his forefinger: 'One, One, Single.'

key_terms.أَحَدٌ: One; an affirmation of divine oneness
key_terms.الثَّنَوِيَّةِ: the Dualists, those who believed in two principles or gods

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Hasan al-'Askari عليه السلام affirm tawhid for someone troubled by Dualist beliefs?
ai.summary: This report recounts how a man was affected by the claims of the Dualists after debating one of them. Imam Abu Muhammad عليه السلام, perceiving his inner doubt, indicated the reality of tawhid with the words 'One, One, Single,' whereupon the man collapsed unconscious.
